description: IXH-6.5 (#5124) intake GuardProfile defaults. Provisional until IXH-1.5 scale measurements refine them. Document bytes / alias / depth continue to come from oas_resource_limits.json (DCW-0.2 mirror); this artifact owns the dimensions that artifact does not.

onViolation.statement: Exceeding any dimension fails the job with a resource-category taxonomy code naming the limit and its configured value; no partial parse result is returned.

maxExpansionRatio.statement: Ceiling on decoded/raw (or expanded/source) byte ratio. Provisional 10:1.

maxEntityCount.statement: Maximum JSON/YAML collection nodes (dict/list leaves counted once). Provisional between the adversarial 1e5-node bomb and scale targets.

maxRefDepth.statement: Maximum $ref / include chase depth before refusal.

maxRefFanout.statement: Maximum number of $ref / include edges leaving one node.

stageWallClockSeconds.statement: Per-pipeline-stage wall-clock ceiling. Matches the IXH-1.4 adversarial per-fixture budget.

jobMemoryCeilingBytes.statement: Per-job peak additional heap ceiling (192 MiB). Matches the IXH-1.4 adversarial tracemalloc budget.

elevated.statement: License/paid tier: 2x the default ceilings for bytes (via OAS override), entities, wall-clock, and memory. Expansion ratio, ref depth/fan-out, and archive compression ratio stay at default.

resolution.statement: Explicit env override wins; else an elevated license seat plan maps to elevated; else default.
